title: Frobenius numbers and the first Hilbert coefficients of certain numerical semigroup rings
summary: Let $a,b$ be positive integers. In this note, we study the numerical semigroup $H=\left $ and and the associated numerical semigroup ring $R=k[[H]]$. Under the certain conditions, we provide explicit formulas for the Frobenius number of $H$ and for the first Hilbert coefficient of $R$.
